target.title: fix(restart): keep deferring when pending inspection fails
target.body:
Fixes #104064.

## What Problem This Solves

Gateway restart deferral treated pending-work inspection exceptions as proof that the gateway was idle. That fail-open path could restart while active work still existed but could not be inspected. The first patch fixed the helper retry behavior, but the config-reload caller still cleared its restartPending guard from onCheckError even though the helper now keeps polling. A later config change could therefore start duplicate deferral loops and competing restart preparation.

## Summary

- Treat pending-count inspection exceptions as unknown pending work instead of safe-to-restart.
- Keep the existing deferral lifecycle active after both initial and later getPendingCount failures.
- Preserve the config-reload restartPending guard when retrying inspection failures.
- Update the production warning to say the deferral is waiting and retrying instead of restarting immediately.
- Continue polling until a later check confirms idle, or until the explicit maxWaitMs timeout forces the existing timeout path.

## Evidence

Exact-head validation on 422023a5d715b3833c1683df674ae6b57662e4a7:

- node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/restart.deferral-timeout.test.ts src/gateway/server-reload-handlers.test.ts -> passed; 2 shards, 107 tests.
- node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.non-agents.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test-non-agents.tsbuildinfo -> passed.
- ./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/infra/restart.ts src/infra/restart.deferral-timeout.test.ts src/gateway/server-reload-handlers.ts src/gateway/server-reload-handlers.test.ts -> passed.
- ./node_modules/.bin/oxlint src/infra/restart.ts src/infra/restart.deferral-timeout.test.ts src/gateway/server-reload-handlers.ts src/gateway/server-reload-handlers.test.ts -> passed.
- pnpm check:loc --base upstream/main --head HEAD -> passed.
- git diff --check -> passed.

Focused behavior covered:

- Initial pending inspection throw calls onCheckError, enters deferral with pending=1, and later emits only after a successful idle check.
- Later polling throw calls onCheckError, keeps polling, and later emits only after a successful idle check.
- Config-reload caller keeps restartPending active after an inspection error; a later config restart request does not create duplicate restart emission work.

## Root Cause

The helper and its production caller disagreed about onCheckError semantics. The helper now treats inspection failure as non-terminal, so the caller must keep its deferral guard active until ready, timeout, cancel, or emission settlement.

## Behavior After This Patch

- Initial inspection throw: calls onCheckError, enters deferral with pending=1, and polls again.
- Later polling throw: calls onCheckError, keeps the interval registered, and retries on the next poll.
- Config reload inspection throw: keeps restartPending true and logs waiting/retrying.
- Confirmed pending=0 still emits restart through the normal ready path.
- Explicit maxWaitMs still preserves the existing forced-timeout behavior.
